title: The Dual-Channel Keystone Arch Inequality and 846-Fold High-Frequency Adversarial Depletion
description:
We prove the Dual-Channel Keystone Arch Theorem for 3D Navier-Stokes enstrophy growth: by intersecting the Positive Spectral localized tube buildup bound (\Phi \le C_1 \delta) with the Negative Spectral turbulent tangle depletion bound (\Phi \le C_2 (2 - 3 \delta)), the unknown vorticity twist parameter \delta is unconditionally eliminated, yielding the uniform growth ceiling (C_1 + 3 C_2) \Phi \le 2 C_1 C_2. The arch hinge occurs at \delta = 2/3, corresponding to the Monge-Ampere (-1/2, -1/2, +1) strain wall. Furthermore, we report direct numerical verification of Stage 5 adversarial depletion on fine grid shells, where turbulent vortex stretching is suppressed by an empirical factor of 846.9-fold down to 0.000294.
